requirements.title: List-directed input uses acceptable type forms without blank-as-zero semantics
requirements.definition: Type-appropriate edit-descriptor input forms are accepted except where modified; unacceptable forms cause an error condition; blanks are never zeros and embedded blanks are forbidden in constants except in character and specified complex constants.

pending.unacceptable-form-error: Deferred input-error plan: internal READ record 'abc' into integer differs from control '123' only by noninteger form; future Clause 12 owner must observe IOSTAT portably, not a diagnostic.
pending.embedded-blanks-limited: Deferred negative: record '1 2' for one integer effective item followed by slash differs from '12 /' only by an embedded blank; must isolate separator versus constant parsing before execution.

S13.10.3.1-001 list-directed type-form runtime controls: two complete positive-control programs use exact type-appropriate forms. The edit-compatible fixture reads '42' into an INTEGER and '.TRUE.' into a LOGICAL in separate internal READ controls, requiring 42 and true. The blanks-not-zeros fixture reads '1 2' into two integers and requires 1 then 2, which would fail if the blank were treated as a zero inside one integer constant.

requirements.definition: For r*c, c is an undelimited character constant when the first corresponding effective item is default, ASCII, or ISO 10646 character and the character after r* is nonblank and not a quote; otherwise c is a literal constant.

requirements.title: Complex list-directed input is a parenthesized ordered pair of numeric fields
requirements.definition: A complex effective item is read as a parenthesized real part and imaginary part separated by comma in POINT mode or semicolon in COMMA mode; blanks and record ends may surround the numeric fields, and a record end may occur after the real part or before the imaginary part.

pending.complex-record-end-allowances: Internal READ from records ['(3,', '4)'] into complex; expected parts approximately 3.0 and 4.0.

requirements.title: Character list-directed input permits delimited continuation and preserves listed characters
requirements.definition: A character effective item is read from a possibly delimited sequence of rep-chars of the effective kind; delimited sequences may continue across records, but not between doubled delimiters; record ends do not add characters; blank, comma, semicolon, and slash may appear in default/ASCII/ISO 10646 sequences.

pending.doubled-delimiter-not-split: Deferred input-error plan: split an apostrophe-delimited doubled apostrophe across records and compare with unsplit control; only the forbidden record end between doubled apostrophes differs.
pending.separator-characters-in-delimited-charac: Internal READ record "' ,;/'" into character(len=4); expected exact value ' ,;/'.
